dedupe_keys.name: a novel approach for joint analytical and ml assisted gsnr estimation in flexible optical network

description: Arpanaei, Farhad and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The implemented estimator combines analytical formulae with machine learning to predict quality of transmission. The source reports evaluation on heterogeneous fibre-span profiles and sparsely occupied links, comparing with conventional lightpath-level estimation. Coverage is flexible optical-network performance modelling. It does not state training-set size, exact feature vectors or quantitative errors in the short abstract. The paper documents an existing estimator while availability of trained parameters or a packaged implementation remains unknown. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The estimator supports physical-layer quality assessment of flexible optical paths.
